item.title: Charleston Battery loan out Juan Torres to Club Sport Boys Association for 2026
item.description: The Charleston Battery confirmed Tuesday that winger Juan David Torres has been loaned to Club Sport Boys Association of the Peruvian Liga 1 for the 2026 season, pending league and federation approval.

item.title: Rep. Michael F. Rivers Sr., incoming Legislative Black Caucus chair, endorses Brandon Brown for U.S. Senate
item.description: South Carolina State Rep. Michael F. Rivers Sr., the incoming chairman of the South Carolina Legislative Black Caucus, has endorsed Brandon Brown in the Democratic race for the U.S. Senate

item.title: Gov. McMaster Announces Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Executive Budget
item.description: Governor Henry McMaster today unveiled his Executive Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-2027, which invests more than $1 billion in South Carolina's roads, cuts the income tax, strengthens the state's rainy day savings, and raises teacher pay.

item.title: "The Rising Tide" Hits Charleston Music Hall Tuesday
item.description: Next week, the Lowcountry Literacy Project (LLP) will pull back the curtain on the future of literacy in Charleston. On Tuesday, January 20, the Charleston Music Hall will host the premiere of The Rising Tide

item.title: Missional Capital Group Acquires Moncks Corner Apartment Complex
item.description: Missional Capital Group recently completed the acquisition of The Ranch at Cooper River in Moncks Corner.

item.title: Aloka the Peace Dog Undergoes Surgery at Charleston Veterinary Referral Center
item.description: Charleston Veterinary Referral Center (CVRC) announced that it performed orthopedic surgery on Aloka, widely known as “the Peace Dog,” the beloved canine companion of the Buddhist monks currently undertaking the Walk for Peace across the US

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Frankie Staropoli
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Jenna Arsenault Launches Campaign for South Carolina House District 112
item.description: Jenna Arsenault, a Mount Pleasant resident and longtime mental health advocate, announced today that she is launching her campaign for South Carolina House District 112.

item.title: Battery announce kickoff times, single-game tickets, theme matches for 2026 season
item.description: The Charleston Battery officially unveiled kickoff times and theme matches for the club’s 2025 USL Championship and Prinx Tires USL Cup home schedule, with single-game tickets available for purchase now on SeatGeek.com.

item.title: Costa Launches “Costa Passport 2026”
item.description: Costa in downtown Charleston has announced Costa Passport 2026, a curated, yearlong series of immersive Italian dining experiences designed to bring the country’s regional culinary traditions to life.
